-- Don't cheat. It's not worth it. It sucks for everyone

-- Be concise and specific. 2 + 2 $\neq$ 4 and 5; demonstrate your entire understanding of the question (and only the question) being asked 

-- I give you suggested number of sentences to answer questions. If you instead write paragraphs, you will not finish 

-- Questions are labeled by topic. Answer the questions you are most comfortable with first, and then go back

-- I will be around to answer clarification questions. I must turn into a robot during exam time. If the question gives you an advantage over another student, I must simply say "I can not answer this question." 

-- Reminder: This exam is 15% of your total grade. Take it seriously, but also know that this does not dictate your entire grade for the course
